issue.title: Intermittent mavsdk_server unit test failure
issue.body:
After running many many times, at some point the test `CameraServiceImplTest.sendsMultipleModes` seems to fail in an odd way.

```
[ RUN      ] CameraServiceImplTest.sendsMultipleModes
modes: 
0: Video
1: Video
2: Video
3: Photo
4: Video
5: Unknown
received_modes: 
0: Video
1: Video
2: Video
3: Photo
4: Video
5: Unknown
6: Video
/home/julianoes/src/MAVSDK/src/backend/test/camera_service_impl_test.cpp:434: Failure
Expected equality of these values:
  modes.size()
    Which is: 6
  received_modes.size()
    Which is: 7
```

To reproduce:
```
cmake -DBUILD_BACKEND=ON -DENABLE_MAVLINK_PASSTHROUGH=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -Bbuild/release -S.
cmake --build build/release -j8
while build/release/src/backend/test/unit_tests_backend; do :; done
```
